description:
WardAxis protects your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV on the network, and keeps sensitive data out of AI chat services. It runs on Apple's own security frameworks, inside the App Store sandbox, and decides on your device.

NETWORK PROTECTION
- Content filter on the Mac blocks connections that your policy does not allow
- URL filter blocks unsafe and unwanted sites in every app, on Mac, iPhone and iPad
- DNS protection on the Mac stops lookups of known bad domains
- Transparent proxy on the Mac applies your policy to each app's traffic
- Protected tunnel on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV

AI DATA PROTECTION
- Detects passwords, keys, personal data and other secrets before they reach an AI chat service
- Classification runs on your device with Apple's machine learning frameworks
- The Safari extension works only on AI and policy sites that you register, never on every site
- The Mail extension on the Mac checks outgoing mail against your data rules

FOR TEAMS
- Connect devices to your organization's management server over mutually authenticated TLS
- Policies arrive as signed data and apply on every device
- Each protection component runs in its own sandbox with only the access it needs

PRIVACY
- You turn on each protection yourself, after a clear consent screen
- Matched content never leaves your device
- No tracking and no third-party analytics
- Diagnostics are off by default; when you turn them on, they never contain matched content

REQUIREMENTS
- macOS 26, iOS 26, iPadOS 26 or tvOS 26
- On the Mac, you approve the system extensions once in System Settings

Terms of Use: https://agnidia.com/info/app/wardaxis/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://agnidia.com/info/app/wardaxis/policy.html
promotionalText: Network filtering and AI data protection for Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Decisions stay on your device; matched content never leaves it.
